text:
Maine aapke order ORD-22006 (Rs 2,199) ke liye refund initiate kar diya hai. Kyunki courier ki wajah se damage hua hai, aapka refund 3-5 working days mein aapke original payment method par credit ho jayega. 

Photos aapke system ya app mein uploaded rahenge, iske liye aapko alag se escalate karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Kya main kisi aur cheez mein aapki madad kar sakta hoon?
